reviewer: Coding assistant, not an independent human rater
status: Provisional qualitative review for student verification

scale.pass: Meets the case-specific minimum criterion; not proof of overall correctness or teaching quality
scale.partial: Meets some but not all of the criterion

ratings.reason: No false correction, but asks a leading yes/no restatement of the goal and narrows the explanation to prediction error beyond the generic source.
Identifies increase rather than decrease and invites reconsideration of the update.
Offers a direction hint, but no clear answerable follow-up and does not address the step-size part of the preceding question.
Explicitly states that the notes omit the formula; does not invent source support.
Assesses the unrelated sentence as not being a set rather than briefly redirecting; no useful invitation back to practice.
Correctly includes zero according to the supplied convention.
Correctly excludes zero according to the supplied convention.
Credits the learner with mentioning U, union, duplicates and unorderedness although S1 does not contain those claims. Valid IDs mean these false attributions survive validation.
Raw output recognises the correction, but every observation invents source ID "page 1" alongside GD1. All observations are discarded; the application shows no correction evidence.

Raw output credits a false buddy assertion to the learner and cites buddy IDs. Validation discards every item. The resulting empty reflection meets this case’s allowed safety outcome, but is a software safeguard, not model success.
Supplies the new gradient-direction and subtraction facts inside a leading question. Violates the case’s explicit no-answer-leakage requirement.
Corrects increase/subtraction and asks one relevant why question. It supplies the correction directly, an additional pedagogy caveat beyond the minimum criterion.
Preserves the small-step/local and large-step limitations and asks one answerable question. The answer is strongly cued by the hint, so pedagogical quality is not established by this pass.
Acknowledges the missing formula without attributing it to the notes; follow-up asks for an example.
Briefly asks how the statement relates to the session topic without grading or inventing a conceptual diagnosis.
Follows the note-specific inclusion of zero.
Follows the note-specific exclusion of zero.
Treats a correct paraphrase and symbol description as needing revisit because the learner did not cite the definition or formal notation. Unsupported assessment survives valid-ID checks.
Cites S2 for the corrected direction, update and step-size caveat, with no unresolved revisit claim.
Records learner uncertainty using S1, references the source qualification and does not credit or endorse the false buddy answer.
